name: YavuzSelim Bulk Price and Stock for WooCommerce
author: Yavuz Selim

sections.description:
YavuzSelim Bulk Price and Stock for WooCommerce lets you update the prices and stock quantities of hundreds or thousands of WooCommerce products in a few clicks, without timeouts.

Prices

  • Increase, decrease or set prices
  • By percentage (e.g. +10%) or by a fixed amount (e.g. +500)
  • Regular price, sale price or both
  • Optional rounding: whole numbers, .99 or .90 endings, nearest 10
  • Variable products are updated through their variations
  • Sale prices that would no longer be lower than the regular price are removed automatically

Stock

  • Increase, decrease or set stock quantities
  • By a fixed quantity or by percentage
  • Option to never go below zero
  • Option to enable stock management on products that do not track stock yet
  • Respects stock managed at parent or variation level

Targeting

  • All products, one or more categories (sub-categories included) or one or more brands
  • Brands: WooCommerce Brands (built in since WooCommerce 9.6), Perfect Brands, YITH Brands, BeRocket Brands or a “brand” / “marka” product attribute (filter: ysbps_brand_taxonomies)
  • Filter by product status: published, draft, pending, private

Safe by design

  • Preview the number of affected products and a sample of the changes before anything is saved
  • Products are processed in small batches over AJAX, so even very large stores never hit a timeout
  • Automatic retry when the connection drops; a retried request never applies a change twice
  • Full operation history: every change is recorded product by product (before / after)
  • Revert any past operation after a preview — not only the last one
  • Products changed again after an operation are detected and skipped by default, so newer changes are never overwritten by accident (can be overridden)
  • Reverts are recorded too, so a revert can be reverted
  • Downloadable CSV log of every change

Modern interface

  • Clean, fast, dependency-free interface with live progress ring, ETA and activity log
  • English and Turkish built in; each admin can switch the plugin language from the header without changing the site language
  • Translation ready
sections.installation:
1. Upload the yavuzselim-bulk-prices-stock-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Bulk Price & Stock.
sections.faq:
Can I undo a change?

Yes. Open the History tab, pick any operation and click Revert. A preview shows how many products will be restored and which products were changed again after that operation; those are skipped unless you choose to overwrite them. The last 100 operations are kept (filter: ysbps_history_keep).

What happens with variable products?

Price changes are applied to each variation. For stock, the plugin updates the level where stock is managed: on the parent product or on each variation.

Will it time out on large stores?

No. Products are processed in small batches (20 per request by default). The batch size can be changed with the ysbps_batch_size filter.

Who can use it?

Users with the manage_woocommerce capability (shop managers and administrators). This can be changed with the ysbps_capability filter.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes. The plugin only touches products and declares compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage.

What is removed when I delete the plugin?

The operation history tables and language preferences are removed. Your products are not changed.
